title: Auth — OOB Redeem — payload
description: The starter turns an approved out-of-band request into the outcome its purpose defines — for `login`, a session bound to the starter key. Issued and signed by the starter key; held as a long poll until the request is approved. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

Response.title: Auth — OOB Redeem — response payload
Response.description: For `login`: who is now signed in, for the starter's "Continue as …?" confirmation. Never tokens: over HTTPS the session itself is delivered as HttpOnly cookies.

subject.description: The approving DID — the grant's issuer — now the session's subject.

displayName.description: A name for the signed-in identity, for the confirmation step. Untrusted wherever rendered.

notAfter.description: When the session ends, as integer UTC epoch seconds: the earlier of the grant's `notAfter` and the service's session limit.

amr.description: Authentication Methods References (RFC 8176) for the session. For this family: `["did", "oob", "uv"]`.
